svg.title: What crypto salaries are paid in, 2024 survey
svg.desc: Stacked bar of crypto-denominated pay: USDC 63 percent, USDT 29 percent, other assets 8 percent. Fewer than 10 percent of workers take any crypto pay.
svg.text: Crypto-denominated pay by asset, 2024 (share of crypto salaries)
Stablecoins cover 90%+ of crypto salaries; <10% of workers take any crypto pay.
Fewer than one in ten workers takes crypto pay at all (3% in 2023, ~9.6% in 2024).
Default to stablecoin base with native-token upside on four-year vesting.
